title: NBA GM 2025-26 NBA Stats API historical identity and player performance evidence

upstream.origin: stats.nba.com NBA API 2025-26 regular-season player totals, shared as third-party pinned CSV

notes: NBA season-specific player IDs are high-confidence NBA API sourced identity leads, not direct profile-level live roster or final canonical ID certification.
2025-26 team and broad position may differ from 2026-27 roster; use separate official NBA 30-team roster crosswalk for current membership.
No 2025-26 source row is NOT a zero grade or proof of rookie status; explicit injury/non-play and first-year analysis required.
Stats computed from totals and games=NBA API wins+losses; per-game rounded to two decimals; true shooting uses standard 0.44 FTA approximation.
No box-score stat alone confirms scouting, shot difficulty, defense, passing decisions or six individual trait ratings. Nothing is auto-graded.
